chapters.title: Security, least privilege and prompt injection
Cost, generative AI and rapid fire

takeaways: AI agents now write most of the code, but developers are still needed to understand business rules, provide good context and orchestrate the agents.
Microsoft Agent Framework lets .NET teams expose existing functions to AI through MCP and connect multiple models with little code.
Security comes first: give agents least privilege, expose only small purpose-built functions and add guardrails against prompt injection.
hook: AI has moved from autocomplete to agents that plan and write most of the code, and developers wonder what is left for them. Microsoft MVP Andre Baltieri shares how he builds with AI coding agents, Microsoft Agent Framework and .NET, and why context, RAG and security matter more than model choice. A practical episode for developers and architects moving existing applications into the agentic era.
